data.title: Park Field
data.about:
Wake up in Dubai Hills estate to lush, manicured lawns  and serene flyaways. Offering 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments with the iconic Burj Khalifa and Dubai skyline as a backdrop.

Stay in a sophisticated community that encourages peak performance on a daily basis. Located in central Dubai with easy access to Al Khail Road.

location_tile.title: Park Field sits overlooking the Dubai Hills park and is conveniently located near the city’s most popular attractions.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The planned Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro lines will provide quick and easy access to airports and other emirates.

  • 12 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 15 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 20 mins – Dubai Int’l airport
  • 25 mins – Al Maktoum Int’l airport
